stock.description: Operating as an investment holding company, Amasse Capital Holdings Limited delivers corporate finance and investment advisory expertise across Hong Kong. It offers financial guidance to publicly traded entities, investors targeting control or investment in listed corporations, and independent board committees or shareholders of these companies. The firm also undertakes roles as an underwriter or placing agent for its clients, notably without holding client assets during these transactional dealings. Established in 2012, its principal office is located in Central, Hong Kong. Amasse Capital Holdings Limited is a subsidiary of Access Cheer Limited.
